This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, 
which must be performed every 15 years as indicated by Y in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Amr gaber, tested by eng. 
Mohammed Abbas & eng. Mohammed Elbayaa

A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category

Maintenance staff 
 should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is

سياج أمان مع 
 مطلوب علامات التحذير المحيطة بمنطقة العمل

Personal protective 
 equipment must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc)

The operator, who is 
 inside the stator, is deprived from any metallic or magnetic object (phones, 
 tape measure, chain)

Protect the inferior 
 part of end winding and core, with a rubber carpet or plastic film which 
 will move with a make progress expertise

Supply of necessity, by 
 intermediate of separate cubicle, the eventual appliance, and lighting put 
 on work inside the core stator

sections.text:
Remove the brushes of generator, exciter and earthing brushes 
 from their holders

Before and after cleaning brushes slip ring contact measure the 
 insulation resistance between slip ring and earth by using megger device 500 
 V.D.C. "approximately ≥ 10 M Ω"

Before and after cleaning brushes holders measure the insulation 
 resistance between holders and earth by using megger device 500 V.D.C. 
 "approximately ≥ 10 MΩ"
Put holders in their position and tightening it

Check the clearance between brushes holders and slip ring 
 "approximately 2 m.m"
Replace the brush by a new one

Check brushes must move freely in the holders and must sit to the 
 rings by their full surface.
يجب التحقق من ربط قضيب الفرش.

Measure the current in each brush (the current in any brush must 
 be 12A/cm2 تقريبًا.
